summary: Implementation plan to expand the Sanskritam curriculum with all 45 foundational units (Chapters 1–12), research and author 5 new advanced scholarly chapters (Chapters 13–17 covering Vedic Sanskrit, Darśana & Upaniṣads, Nāṭyaśāstra & Kāvya, Āyurveda/Jyotiṣa/Śāstras, and Pāṇinian Dhātupāṭha & Gaṇapāṭha), regenerate the complete Sanskritam-Curriculum.pdf on disk, and add an interactive in-app PDF Book Viewer & Exporter.
